title: ADLS Gen2 organization and access
summary: Separate storage layout from access-control design and lifecycle policy.

blocks.text: Separate storage layout from access-control design and lifecycle policy.

items: Use predictable zones such as raw/bronze, refined/silver and curated/gold only when they map to real contracts.
Prefer Microsoft Entra identities/managed identities over shared account keys.
Directory ACLs and role assignments solve different layers of authorization.
Lifecycle policies can move/delete old data, but should respect retention requirements.
